season.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=20) ('Season Open from May 15 to October 1'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35. S sites 2, 17, 22, 23, 24, 37, 38, 47, 48, 50 and 53 won't fit a 23-ft rig, and that includes electric sites 22 and 24. Site 41 is administrative; 27 is walk-in tent.

facilities.source: https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/peakskenny.jpg (legend symbols for showers and dump station), read 2026-11-02

note: Wooded knoll on the South Cove peninsula of Sebec Lake; two loops with a center exit road. Six sites (22, 24, 25, 26, 55, 56) have electric and water, the rest no hookups. Sites 2, 19, 27, 28, 35 and 38 aren't reservable. Gravel access road is potholed but passable. Sand beach + canoe/kayak rental at a separate day-use area reached by foot trail, five minutes away; trailered boats launch at a public ramp two miles off. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 56 sites, season 05-15..10-01, water; added showers, dump, site classes. Note cleaned (5 hookup sites -> the map's 6). Booking, fees stand.
flags: WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: the park page's 'nestled on the shore' and 'more than a mile of shoreline' are park-level. The map's 'Sebec Lake' across the top is schematic; the page says 'The camping area, a five-minute walk from the beach'. OSM and imagery put the loops ~200+ m from the shore through forest. Canopy hides the sites, so no lake view could be seen or ruled out; lakeview isn't proven and it doesn't go up.

PIN: stored 45.2577,-69.27669 is the park's published point near the ranger station (OSM 45.2585,-69.27761), ~1.07 km E of the campground. Corrected ~45.2598,-69.2900: from OSM camp-road geometry plus a bathhouse roof seen on imagery near 45.2600,-69.2902; the pads themselves are under canopy.
HOOKUPS: electric is not stored; the map marks six electric+water sites, but no page states the amperage, so I left it. Of the six, 22 and 24 are class S and won't fit, leaving 25U, 26X, 55X and 56U.

BOOKING: the page's older text says 'minimum 2-night stay' and a 2-business-day lead, and its rules '14-day maximum stay during July and August'; the stored min_stay (2 nights on weekends for bookings before July 1) came from the later reservation-tips page, which is 403 today, so I left the group. The public index says online season 5/18-9/13/2026 and all sites first-come from 9/14.

UNREAD: the state's site-search refuses out of season, so per-site lengths weren't read; maine.gov/dacf/parks pages answer 403 to plain HTTP and I didn't work around it (including the park guide and the Google Earth campsite KML), so fee and season text stays from the earlier read.
